# Vasile Pop (vicusbass)

> Freelance software developer and senior SDET based in Cluj-Napoca, Romania, working remotely with clients worldwide. 21+ years in software testing; builds websites, web and mobile apps, AI agents, integrations, backends and custom CRM/ERP systems. English and Romanian.

## Services

- [Web design & branding](https://www.vicusbass.com/services#web-design): branding and UI design in partnership with Symbold (https://www.symbold.ro), a branding studio in Cluj.
- [Websites & web apps](https://www.vicusbass.com/services#websites): Astro, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Sanity CMS, Vercel.
- [Mobile apps](https://www.vicusbass.com/services#mobile-apps): cross-platform iOS and Android apps.
- [AI agents](https://www.vicusbass.com/services#ai-agents): support assistants, document extraction, tool-calling agents (MCP), with evals.
- [Integrations](https://www.vicusbass.com/services#integrations): REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, payments, accounting and CRM sync.
- [Software testing & QA automation](https://www.vicusbass.com/services#testing): test strategy, QA audits, Playwright, pytest, k6, CI.
- [Python & Node.js services](https://www.vicusbass.com/services#backend): APIs, background jobs, scrapers, data pipelines.
- [Custom CRM & ERP apps](https://www.vicusbass.com/services#crm-erp): Frappe / ERPNext or a custom stack.
